combo_label: Barbecues × Fossil Hunting × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Man's voice pitched between the highest and the lowest of the male ranges
Reef-building polyp whose stony remains crowd Carboniferous limestone
Intimate place of worship inside a college, castle or hospital
Curly sign at the start of written music, fixing the pitch that follows
Mary of Lyme Regis, finder of ichthyosaurs and barred from the Geological Society
Bubbling delight, and the kind of club where singers meet for part-songs
Strip between high and low water where loose beach finds may be collected
Cold canned lager handed round while the coals are still getting going
Uncooked; juices from poultry in this state carry bugs to anything ready to eat
Shredded cabbage and carrot in mayonnaise, the tub that comes back untouched
